title: 第008章 时间阵法研究第009章 血魔陨落
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家

华纪55年8月1日，华夏物理研究所。
空间折叠技术刚刚进入量产阶段，周明教授的团队还没来得及喘口气，新的任务就来了。这一次，他们的目标是——时间。
上古仙府第六层的修炼区中，有一座时间加速密室。密室不大，只有二十平方米，但内部的时间流速是外部的十倍。也就是说，在密室内修炼十天，外界只过去了一天。这座密室是天罡宗立宗十万年来从未示人的最高机密，也是上古仙尊留给后人的最珍贵的遗产之一。
玄霜站在物理研究所的全息投影前，手指在空中虚画，勾勒出时间加速密室的阵法结构图。那是一个极其复杂的多层符文阵列，由三万六千个基础符文组成，分为十二层，每层三千个符文。符文之间相互嵌套、相互制衡，形成一个精密的“时间场”，能够在局部区域内改变时间的流速。
“时间阵法的原理，比空间禁制复杂百倍。”玄霜的声音依然清冷，“空间是三维的，时间是第四维。改变时间，意味着要触摸宇宙的底层法则。上古时期能够布置时间阵法的仙尊，不超过十人。”
“那这座密室是谁建的？”周明教授问。
“天道仙尊。”玄霜说，“他在飞升前，用了整整一千年时间，才完成了这座时间加速密室。之后的几万年里，天罡宗历任宗主都在尝试复制，但没有一个人成功。”
周明教授的眼睛亮了。
“也就是说，这座密室是不可复制的孤品？”
“理论上是的。”玄霜点头，“但你们之前破解了空间禁制，也许……也许你们能用科技的手段，绕过符文，直接实现时间加速。”
周明教授沉思片刻，调出了时间加速密室的详细扫描数据。ai“伏羲”已经在过去的一个月里完成了对密室的全方位扫描，建立了精确的数学模型。数据显示，时间加速的核心机制与空间折叠有异曲同工之处——都是在更高维度上对现实进行“操作”。空间折叠是在第四维度上弯曲三维空间，而时间加速是在第五维度上扭曲第四维时间。
“如果我们把宇宙想象成一本书。”周明教授在白板上画了一个简单的示意图，“每一页代表一个瞬间。时间流动，就是翻页。正常速度是一秒翻一页。时间加速，就是一次翻多页。时间减速，就是翻页变慢。时间停止，就是停止翻页。”
“那时间倒流呢？”台下有研究员问。
周明教授沉默了片刻。
“时间倒流，就是把已经翻过去的页翻回来。理论上可行，但需要的能量……大到无法想象。而且涉及因果律，可能引发悖论。暂时不考虑。”
他转向ai“伏羲”的分析面板。
“伏羲，时间加速的能量消耗是多少？”
“根据上古仙府时间加速密室的运行数据，维持十倍时间加速，每秒消耗的灵能量相当于十枚元婴巅峰修士的自爆。”ai“伏羲”回答，“以我们目前的灵能供应能力，最多只能维持三倍加速。”
“三倍？太低了。”周明教授皱眉，“我们要的是百倍、千倍。”

“除非找到更高效的能量供应方式。”
周明教授陷入沉思。玄霜之前说过，时间阵法消耗巨大，所以上古仙尊只建了十倍加速，而且只能供少数人使用。但华夏联盟的优势在于——他们有工业化生产的灵能反应堆，有反物质能源，有无穷无尽的灵石矿脉。也许，他们可以用“量”来换“效率”。
“如果用灵能反应堆直接供能呢？”他问。
ai“伏羲”快速计算。
“灵能反应堆的输出功率是上古灵脉的十倍。如果用十座灵能反应堆并联供能，理论上可以将时间加速倍数提升到五十倍。但能量损耗率极高，约百分之七十。”
“百分之七十的损耗，换五十倍加速，值了。”周明教授说。
“还有更好的方案。”ai“伏羲”继续说，“如果将反物质反应堆与灵能反应堆结合，利用反物质湮灭产生的纯能量驱动时间阵法，能量损耗率可降至百分之三十，加速倍数可提升至一百倍。”
一百倍。
周明教授的手指在颤抖。一百倍的时间加速，意味着在实验室里研究一百天，外界只过去一天。别人需要一百年才能完成的研究，他们一年就能完成。
“立即设计方案。”他说，“我要在最短的时间内，建成华夏联盟自己的时间加速实验室。”
消息传到张德华那里时，他正在视察空间戒指的生产线。
“时间加速？”张德华听到这个词的时候，眼睛猛地亮了，“能加速多少倍？”
“理论上可达一百倍。”周明教授在通讯器那头说，“但需要反物质反应堆供能，而且能量消耗巨大。”
“能量不是问题。”张德华说，“反物质反应堆，我们有三座。灵能反应堆，有五十座。够不够？”
周明教授愣住了。
“三座反物质反应堆？我们什么时候有的？”
“上个月刚从本土运过来的。”张德华笑道，“专门为远征军准备的。不过如果时间加速实验室更需要，可以先调两座过来。”
“够！太够了！”周明教授激动得声音都变了调，“两座反物质反应堆加十座灵能反应堆，足够维持一百倍加速持续运转！”
“好。”张德华点头，“全力研发。需要什么资源，直接打报告，我签字。”
挂断通讯后，他看向窗外。

“一百倍时间加速。”他喃喃道，“别人修炼一百年，我们只需要一年。别人研究一百年，我们只需要一年。这个差距，谁能追上？”
他的嘴角微微上扬。
“系统。”

August 1, 55 BC, Huaxia Institute of Physics.
Space folding technology has just entered the mass production stage. Before Professor Zhou Ming's team could take a breath, a new task came. This time, their goal is time.
In the training area on the sixth floor of the Ancient Immortal Mansion, there is a time acceleration chamber. The secret room is not big, only twenty square meters, but the flow rate of time inside is ten times that of the outside. In other words, after practicing in a secret room for ten days, only one day has passed outside. This secret room is the top secret that has never been revealed to anyone in the 100,000 years since the founding of the Tiangang Sect. It is also one of the most precious legacies left to future generations by the ancient Immortal Lord.
Xuan Shuang stood in front of the holographic projection of the Institute of Physics, and drew with his fingers in the air, outlining the formation structure of the time acceleration chamber. It was an extremely complex multi-layered rune array, consisting of thirty-six thousand basic runes, divided into twelve layers, each layer containing three thousand runes. The runes are nested within each other and check and balance each other, forming a precise "time field" that can change the flow rate of time in a local area.
"The principle of time formation is a hundred times more complicated than space restriction." Xuan Shuang's voice was still cold, "Space is three-dimensional, and time is the fourth dimension. Changing time means touching the underlying laws of the universe. In ancient times, there were no more than ten immortals who could arrange time formation."
"Then who built this secret room?" Professor Zhou Ming asked.
"Tiandao Immortal," Xuan Shuang said, "before he ascended, it took him a full thousand years to complete this time acceleration chamber. In the following tens of thousands of years, successive Tiangang Sect leaders tried to copy it, but no one succeeded."
Professor Zhou Ming’s eyes lit up.
"In other words, this secret room is an unique item that cannot be copied?"
"Theoretically yes." Xuan Shuang nodded, "But you have cracked the space restriction before. Maybe... maybe you can use technological means to bypass the runes and directly accelerate time."
Professor Zhou Ming thought for a moment and called up the detailed scan data of the time acceleration chamber. AI "Fuxi" has completed an all-round scan of the secret room in the past month and established an accurate mathematical model. The data shows that the core mechanism of time acceleration is similar to that of space folding - they both "operate" reality in a higher dimension. Space folding is the bending of three-dimensional space in the fourth dimension, while time acceleration is the distortion of the fourth-dimensional time in the fifth dimension.
"If we imagine the universe as a book." Professor Zhou Ming drew a simple diagram on the whiteboard. "Each page represents a moment. The flow of time means turning pages. The normal speed is turning one page in one second. The acceleration of time means turning multiple pages at once. The deceleration of time means turning pages slower. The stop of time means stopping turning pages."
"What about going back in time?" a researcher in the audience asked.
Professor Zhou Ming was silent for a moment.
"Going back in time means turning back the page that has been turned. It is theoretically possible, but the energy required...is unimaginable. And it involves the law of cause and effect, which may lead to paradoxes. I won't consider it for now."
He turned to the analysis panel of AI "Fuxi".
"Fuxi, how much energy does time acceleration consume?"
"According to the operating data of the time acceleration chamber in the ancient immortal mansion, to maintain ten times the time acceleration, the spiritual energy consumed per second is equivalent to the self-destruction of ten Nascent Soul peak monks." AI "Fuxi" replied, "With our current spiritual energy supply capacity, we can only maintain three times the acceleration at most."
"Three times? Too low." Professor Zhou Ming frowned, "We want a hundred times or a thousand times."
"Unless a more efficient way of supplying energy is found."
Professor Zhou Ming fell into deep thought. Xuan Shuang said before that the time formation consumes a lot of money, so the Ancient Immortal Lord only built ten times acceleration, and it can only be used by a few people. But the advantage of the Chinese Alliance is that they have industrially produced psychic reactors and antimatter energy.There are endless veins of spiritual stones. Perhaps, they can trade "volume" for "efficiency."
"What if the psychic reactor is used to directly supply energy?" he asked.
AI "Fuxi" calculates quickly.
"The output power of the psychic reactor is ten times that of the ancient spiritual veins. If ten psychic reactors are used to supply energy in parallel, the time acceleration factor can theoretically be increased to fifty times. However, the energy loss rate is extremely high, about 70%."
"Seventy percent of the loss is worth 50 times of acceleration," said Professor Zhou Ming.
"There is a better solution." AI "Fuxi" continued, "If the antimatter reactor is combined with the psychic reactor, and the pure energy generated by the annihilation of antimatter is used to drive the time array, the energy loss rate can be reduced to 30%, and the acceleration factor can be increased to one hundred times."
A hundred times.
Professor Zhou Ming’s fingers were trembling. A hundred times acceleration of time means that one hundred days of research in the laboratory will last only one day in the outside world. They can complete research that takes others a hundred years to complete in one year.
"Design a plan immediately." He said, "I want to build the Chinese Alliance's own time acceleration laboratory in the shortest possible time."
When the news reached Zhang Dehua, he was inspecting the production line of the space ring.
"Time accelerates?" When Zhang Dehua heard this word, his eyes suddenly lit up, "How many times can it be accelerated?"
"Theoretically, it can be a hundred times greater." Professor Zhou Ming said over the communicator, "But it requires an antimatter reactor to provide energy, and the energy consumption is huge."
"Energy is not a problem." Zhang Dehua said, "We have three antimatter reactors and fifty psychic reactors. Are they enough?"
Professor Zhou Ming was stunned.
"Three antimatter reactors? When did we have them?"
"It was just shipped from the mainland last month." Zhang Dehua said with a smile, "Specially prepared for the expeditionary force. However, if the Time Acceleration Laboratory needs it more, we can transfer two of them first."
"Enough! That's enough!" Professor Zhou Ming was so excited that his voice changed tone, "Two antimatter reactors plus ten psychic reactors are enough to maintain continuous operation at a hundred times acceleration!"
"Okay." Zhang Dehua nodded, "Go all out on research and development. If you need any resources, just report them and I'll sign."
After hanging up the communication, he looked out the window.
"Time is accelerated a hundred times." He murmured, "It only takes one year for others to practice for a hundred years. It only takes one year for others to study for a hundred years. Who can catch up with this gap?"
The corners of his mouth raised slightly.
"system."
